verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents a REST API that exposes card and bank statements, receipt downloads, transaction reconciliation, and linked receipt and invoice files. It authenticates with OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, and each credential can only reach the routes of the scopes granted to it. The API reference includes an interactive playground. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, endpoint-level detail for the transaction and expense listing routes, and a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull transactions, expenses, and receipts through a documented REST API with OAuth and scoped tokens

citations.quote: Access card and bank statements, download receipts, update and reconcile transactions.
Link receipts and invoices to existing transactions and download the linked files.
The Conta Simples API uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials for authentication.
A credential can only access the routes of the scopes granted to it, and scopes cannot be edited afterwards.
